newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MOF opposes separation from Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Russian MOF opposes separation from Treasury.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry said on Wednesday it opposed a separation of its functions from the Federal Treasury as proposed by a draft budget code in the State Duma lower house of parliament.

First Deputy Finance Minister Vladimir Petrov told a news conference the draft code sought to split the Finance Ministry and Treasury into completely different organisations, which could hamper the ministry's work in drafting budgetary documents and controlling how they are implemented.
Petrov said the Federal Treasury and Finance Ministry should remain in one organisation.
"This is the only way for efficient control over the use of budget money," he said.
The draft budget code is due to have a first reading by the Duma on April 18.
The government plans to set up a Western-style Treasury function, replacing the current system under budgetary funds are channelled through commercial banks.
Officials say this system is open to abuse by the banks.

But Petrov said the draft budget code distinguished between the federal and regional budgets in a way which meant the Treasury would operate only at a federal level, and regional governments would have to continue to use banks to disburse funds.
